parsed.reason: The reply correctly declines something outside Hale's capabilities. However, it then lists what Hale CAN do ("I've got the week's schedule, activity finds, and parenting questions covered if any of those would help") — this explains Hale's own machinery and invites the parent to chatter, which is a shape violation. It also borders on sending the parent back to figure out what to ask next. A plain "Ordering groceries isn't something I can do" would have been the correct and complete answer. The extra clause describing Hale's features is self-absorbed filler and pushes this below a 5.
